label: I am a Nigerian citizen
helper: NELFUND is a Nigerian government student loan programme.

label: I have my NIN (National Identification Number)
helper: You'll need this for identity verification. Get it from NIMC if you don't have one.

label: I have my JAMB registration number
helper: Used to match your admission and examination record.

label: I have my admission information ready
helper: Admission letter or confirmation details from your institution.

label: I have my matriculation/student number
helper: Check your institution's student portal or ID card if unsure.

label: I have a valid personal bank account
helper: Ideally one opened in your own full legal name.

label: I have my BVN (Bank Verification Number)
helper: Linked to the bank account you plan to use.

label: My name matches across NIN, JAMB, bank, and school records
helper: Even small spelling differences can cause verification issues.

label: My institution/student record is available for verification
helper: Meaning your institution has your registration data on file and, ideally, submitted it to NELFUND.

label: I have confirmed with OOU whether my student record has been uploaded to NELFUND
helper: OOU submits student records to NELFUND in its own process — checking ahead can save you a failed verification attempt.

label: My OOU matriculation number matches my OOU student portal exactly
helper: Copy it directly from the OOU student portal rather than typing from memory, to avoid a mismatch.
